dialogues.speaker: Association Announcement
dialogues.text: "The Saurian Relics Association is always hiring literature analysis specialists, cultural artifact provenance specialists, and expert excavators! What we don't offer in terms of base salary, we make up for with unlimited potential!"

dialogues.speaker: Association Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you dig up priceless relics, not only will you gain unimaginable wealth, but your fame will spread throughout the land, making you a star in both adventuring and archaeology at a single stroke!"

dialogues.speaker: Association Announcement
dialogues.text: "And if you'd prefer less strenuous work, then many of the Association's dig sites are hiring administrative and security personnel, so you can kick back and work in comfort."

dialogues.speaker: Association Announcement
dialogues.text: "Well, sound tempting? If so, see us for details!"
